name: Lucrezia Borgia
contribution: An Italian-Spanish noblewoman of the House of Borgia who was the illegitimate daughter of Pope Alexander VI and Vannozza dei Cattanei.
legacy: In 1499 this person was appointed as Governor of Spoleto, a role usually reserved solely for cardinals, becoming the first female governor in the Papal States in a territory crucial for the passage from the Tyrrhenian to the Adriatic Sea.
image_credit: Attributed to Dosso Dossi · Public domain

checks.lead: Lucrezia Borgia (18 April 1480 – 24 June 1519) was an Italian-Spanish noblewoman of the House of Borgia who was the illegitimate daughter of Pope Alexander VI and Vannozza dei Cattanei. She was a former governor of Spoleto.
